course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Summarize short public information and add a brief personal response in an appropriate register.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A local notice or short article affects daily life and prompts a short reaction.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Separating summary from opinion while keeping tone clear and balanced.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a short public-information text about local services, summarize the main point, and add a brief reaction.

main_focus.name: source framing plus balanced reaction
main_focus.description: Use source-framing phrases to distinguish what the text says from a personal view.
model_examples: Enligt informationen ändras öppettiderna nästa vecka.
Min egen reaktion är att det verkar praktiskt men lite sent.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2-3 source-framing phrases and 2-3 personal-reaction phrases naturally.

useful_chunks: Det är praktiskt för vissa, men...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use public-information words and summary phrases without turning the task academic.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions a short public-information text or notice.
dialogue_shape.middle: They separate the main point from details and discuss one practical effect.
dialogue_shape.ending: They give a brief balanced reaction and decide what to do with the information.

target_complexity.repetition: source framing and personal reaction should stay clearly separate

focus: the main point of the public information
the practical effect on daily life
the contrast between the summary and the personal reaction

sentence_focus: one sentence beginning with Enligt informationen
one sentence with Det viktigaste är att
one sentence giving a personal reaction
one sentence contrasting a practical benefit and drawback
